1479-5700-5701-8338-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-8338-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

3995-4289-7008.easyPrerequisites: Horseshoe Crab doesn't have summoning sickness.
3995-4289-7008.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4499-6720-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2158-3249-6112--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-3249-6112--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Fumulus triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1479-2841-7201-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-7201-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Sapling Nursery and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sapling Nursery triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2440-7108-7109-7730.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-7108-7109-7730.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

3532-5078-5901-7742.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
Artist's Talent is at least level 2.
3532-5078-5901-7742.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Machinesmith Automaton.
Repeat.

851-4871-6705.description:
Activate Quina by paying {2} and sacrificing a Frog.
When the Frog dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens and two 1/1 Frog creature tokens due to Quina and Adrix and Nev.
Resolve the Quina ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1809-1987-4276-7487.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1809-1987-4276-7487.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Returned Pastcaller and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Returned Pastcaller and Zealous Lorecaster enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1809-1987-4276-7487.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1603-4004-7149.description:
Cast Evil Twin by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Evil Twin into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Evil Twin dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Evil Twin enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Evil Twin leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Evil Twin from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

104-3490-5231-6720.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-5231-6720.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2279-2511-5058.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2793-3334-3921-5089-6320.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Saheeli's first ability triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli's second ability triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus that is a 5/5 artifact creature.
Put the nontoken Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule and its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting three loyalty counters on it.
At the beginning of the end step, Saheeli triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Ugin's Nexus token. The token put into exile due to its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting Ugin's Nexus into your hand from exile.
Move to your second extra turn, and repeat from step 1.

4477-4872-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Warp and Greenwarden of Murasa each turn.
4477-4872-6122.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa by paying its mana cost.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

509-625-1267-5546.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Jhoira's Timebug does not have summoning sickness.
509-625-1267-5546.description:
Activate Ashnod's Transmogrant by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Medomai the Ageless and causing it to become an artifact.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Activate Jhoira's Timebug by tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 6.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

You have at least one land card in hand.
Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
Trench Behemoth and Budoka Gardener each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
1323-1993-4543.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Budoka Gardener's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Experiment Kraj.
Repeat.

2557-4636-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

366-4218.description:
Activate The World Tree's second ability by paying {W}{W}{U}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, tapping and sacrificing it, searching your library for Purphoros, if needed, and every other God and/or creature with changeling in your library and put them onto the battlefield.
When the Gods enter the battlefield, Purphoros triggers for each God that entered except itself, if applicable.
Resolve all Purphoros triggers, dealing damage to each opponent equal to twice the number of Gods that entered the battlefield.

116-283-2719.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and another permanent you control.
Activate Sakashima of a Thousand Faces by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

3426-4050-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Deranged Hermit.
Deranged Hermit enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Squirrel tokens, adding {3}.
Repeat.

2024-2251-5168.notablePrerequisites: Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
2024-2251-5168.description:
Cast Quickchange by paying {1}{U}, making a creature you control all colors until end of turn.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{W}{G}, giving Bloom Tender +3/+3 until end of turn and untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

83-687-2034-4350.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul, adding {C}{C}.
Butcher Ghoul's undying ability and Mortician Beetle trigger.
Resolve the Butcher Ghoul trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 and a vigilance counter.
Resolve the Mortician Beetle trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Mortician Beetle and removing both counters from Butcher Ghoul.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul, adding {C}{C}.
Butcher Ghoul's undying ability and Mortician Beetle trigger.
Resolve the Butcher Ghoul trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 and a vigilance counter.
Resolve the Mortician Beetle trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul, adding {C}{C}.
Mortician Beetle triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Resolve the Tayam ability from step 5, causing yourself to mill three cards and return Butcher Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
